dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, what was the biggest news in Bangkok this week?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt wʌz ðə ˈbɪɡɪst ˈnuːz ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈðɪs ˈwiːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The air pollution. It was in all the headlines.
dialogue.reading: ði ˈɛr pəˈluːʃən. ɪt wʌz ɪn ˈɔːl ðə ˈhɛdlaɪnz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What did the news say about it?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt dɪd ðə ˈnuːz ˈseɪ əˈbaʊt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: One report said that the air was very dangerous for children and old people.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌn rɪˈpɔːrt ˈsɛd ðæt ði ˈɛr wʌz ˈvɛri ˈdeɪndʒərəs fər ˈtʃɪldrən ənd ˈoʊld ˈpiːpəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Was there an interview with a doctor?
dialogue.reading: wʌz ðɛr ən ˈɪntərvjuː wɪð ə ˈdɑːktər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. In a TV interview, a doctor said people needed to wear masks outside.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪn ə ˌtiːˈviː ˈɪntərvjuː, ə ˈdɑːktər ˈsɛd ˈpiːpəl ˈniːdɪd tə ˈwɛr ˈmæsks ˌaʊtˈsaɪd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I watched an English broadcast about it. A journalist said the problem was getting worse every year.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɑːtʃt ən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈbrɔːdkæst əˈbaʊt ɪt. ə ˈdʒɜːrnəlɪst ˈsɛd ðə ˈprɑːbləm wʌz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈwɜːrs ˈɛvri ˈjɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. They said that they had a new plan. But the editor of one news website said that the plan wasn't good enough.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðeɪ ˈsɛd ðæt ðeɪ ˈhæd ə ˈnuː ˈplæn. bʌt ði ˈɛdɪtər əv ˈwʌn ˈnuːz ˈwɛbsaɪt ˈsɛd ðæt ðə ˈplæn ˈwʌzənt ˈɡʊd ɪˈnʌf.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think the problem is serious. We need clean air now.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ðə ˈprɑːbləm ɪz ˈsɪriəs. wiː ˈniːd ˈkliːn ˈɛr ˈnaʊ.
